source: sanitized Windows vendor-API phase-invert encoding plus live write/read-back/restore validation

golden_encoding.encoding: one byte per input; zero is normal polarity and one enables phase inversion

live_validation.procedure: read original; write the inverse boolean; read back; restore original; read back
live_validation.result: both temporary values and both restored values matched

limitations: The successful write used the registered Windows vendor API; the underlying USB setup packet has not been captured with USBPcap.
Only firmware 0x018A and the Input 1/2 phase-invert controls are approved by this fixture.
Failure behavior and concurrent Lewitt Control Center interaction remain unverified.
